preconditions.description: The contract must have liquidityFeeonBuy + liquidityFeeonSell + burnFeeOnBuy + burnFeeOnSell = 0, which can be achieved by setting all these fee parameters to zero via owner functions
Attacker must be the contract owner to call setBuyFeePercentages and setSellFeePercentages functions

exploit_hint: As the contract owner, call setBuyFeePercentages and setSellFeePercentages to set all fee parameters (taxFeeonBuy, liquidityFeeonBuy, marketingFeeonBuy, burnFeeOnBuy, taxFeeonSell, liquidityFeeonSell, marketingFeeonSell, burnFeeOnSell) to zero. Then trigger a transfer that calls _takeLiquidity function, which will attempt to divide by zero at line 639: liquidityAmount = tLiquidity * (liquidityFeeonBuy + liquidityFeeonSell) / (liquidityFeeonBuy + liquidityFeeonSell + burnFeeOnBuy + burnFeeOnSell). This will cause a division by zero revert, potentially disrupting fee calculations and contract functionality.
